row: Welcome to Texas Chiropractic College your local chiropractic school in Pasadena TX. With a proud history of helping to prepare tomorrow's chiropractors today, we at Texas Chiropractic College welcome you. We invite you to explore who we are, what we do, and why you should choose us for high quality chiropractic training.
